metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle launched or spinning from minor collision
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a car, truck, or motorcycle suddenly launched into the sky, flipping, or spinning uncontrollably after hitting a small object like a street sign or curb?

metamorphic_relations.name: Heavy object shoots upward without proportionate force
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a shipping container, dumpster, or other heavy object suddenly launched vertically into the sky at high speed with no explosion large enough to justify the movement?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle flies over wall or barrier unnaturally
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a car travel through the air over a wall or barrier without a ramp, explosion, or jump that would explain the trajectory?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle despawns when player approaches
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a parked vehicle abruptly vanish as the player walks toward it or tries to enter it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle or object vanishes from scene suddenly
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a vehicle or large object that is stuck on or resting on something suddenly disappear without any physical cause?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character teleports into or through solid object
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player or an NPC instantly relocate from one position to inside a container or solid object without any transition animation?

metamorphic_relations.name: Wrong animation triggered on interaction
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player trigger a completely wrong animation when interacting with a ladder, ledge, or environmental object?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character or vehicle passes through solid barrier
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player, an NPC, or a vehicle pass directly through a solid wall, fence, gate, or barrier as if it does not exist?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle drives itself without a driver
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a car continue to drive, accelerate, and steer after its driver has visibly stepped out? The driver's seat is empty but the vehicle keeps moving.

metamorphic_relations.name: NPCs walk through obstacles instead of around them
metamorphic_relations.check: Do pedestrian NPCs walk directly into, through, or over obstacles such as bushes, fences, or trash cans instead of walking around them?

metamorphic_relations.name: Player character launched extreme distance
metamorphic_relations.check: Is the player suddenly thrown or propelled an extreme distance from a minor impact such as a slow vehicle bump? The force is wildly disproportionate.

metamorphic_relations.name: Player performs impossibly high or far jump
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player jump from ground level and land directly on a rooftop or high ledge far beyond normal jump height with no intermediate surface?

metamorphic_relations.name: RC car or drone falls through map
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the Jumper (RC car) or quadcopter clip through the ground and fall into the void beneath the game world?

metamorphic_relations.name: Large vehicle launched and spinning by explosion
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a semi-truck, bus, or other large vehicle catapulted high into the air and sent spinning by an explosion too small to justify the force?

metamorphic_relations.name: Exaggerated crash ejection or ragdoll
metamorphic_relations.check: During a vehicle crash, is the rider ejected with wildly exaggerated force, flying an unrealistic distance through the air far beyond what the crash speed would cause?
